facility.name: Rina's Childcare
facility.programs_provided: School Age Care,Before School Care,Meals Provided ,After School Care,Snacks Provided,Part Time Care,Transportation to/from School ,Field Trips

provenance.note: Home-based program: street address, phone and provider name are not shown.

inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Caregivers - Orientation: One carigver has not completed an orientation to the childcare home. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Caregivers - Orientation (26 TAC §747.1303(1)(A))

occurrences.finding: Required Immunizations: Of the four children's records evaluated, one was behind with required immunizations.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Immunizations (26 TAC §747.613(a))

occurrences.finding: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian: The childcare home does not have a health statement for the home's pet.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Animals at Center - Statement of Health from Veterinarian (26 TAC §747.3703(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912): One staff did not have a pre-employment affidavit. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Required Affidavit (Form 2912) (26 TAC §747.901(5))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Procedures parents access minimum standards online, TX A/N hotline, and HHSC website: The operational policies does not inform parents of the website where Minimum Standards can be reviewed. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Procedures for Parents Review Licensing Rules and Reports (26 TAC §747.501(10))

occurrences.finding: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets: The sheets on the playyard mattresses were not fitting snugly. This was corrected at inpsection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety Requirements for Play Yards - Snug Fitting Sheets (26 TAC §747.2311(2)(B))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Recommended Clothing and Footing: The operational policies does not include the recommended type of footwear children should wear.This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Recommended Clothing and Footing (26 TAC §747.501(8)(B))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement: Of the four children's records evaluated, one lacked a health statement from a health care professional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement (26 TAC §747.611(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Of the four children's records evaluated, the following information was missing:  One record lacked special needs information.  One record lacked information water activity permission.  One lacked the name and phone number of the school the school age child attends.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuate and Relocate with Essential Documentation: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how you will evacuate with parent and emergency contact information, authorization for emergency medical treatment and the sign in and out log.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuate and Relocate with Essential Documentation (26 TAC §747.5003(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: The emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms for each child being transported is not in the vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §747.5417(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness- Reunification Plan: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be reunited with their parent once the emergency is over.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness- Reunification Plan (26 TAC §747.5003(5))

occurrences.finding: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required training less than- 5 years experience: The primary caregiver received 3 of the 6 required annual training hours in management techniques, leadership, or staff supervision for the March 2024-March 2025 training year. You will need to receive 3 clock hours of make-up training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Primary Caregiver Annual Training - Required training less than- 5 years experience (26 TAC §747.1309(e)(1))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures: The emergency preparedness plan lacked the following information:  1. How children under the age of and with limited mobility will be evacuated from the home.  2. A copy of the emergency evacuation and relocation diagram.  3. The responsibility of caregivers in a sheltering/lock-down emergency.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Evacuation, Relocation and Sheltering Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(1))

occurrences.finding: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on: The primary and assistant caregivers all completed CPR training on-line. The on-line course does not include the use of a CPR manikin and hands-on skill-based instruction, practice, and testing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Pediatric First-Aid and Pediatric CPR Training -skill based and hands on (26 TAC §747.1313(b))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguisher has not been serviced within the past  year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §747.5107(b))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident: A child sfaty seat that expired was being used to transport a child. This was corrected at inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident (26 TAC §747.5407(b))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness-Continuity of Care: The emergency preparedness plan does not state how children will be cared for until the emergency is over.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness-Continuity of Care (26 TAC §747.5003(4))

occurrences.finding: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Communication Procedures: The emergency preparedness plan does not include an emergency phone number for the child care home and does not state how you will communicate with local authorities and Child Care Regulation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Emergency Preparedness Plan - Communication Procedures (26 TAC §747.5003(2))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: Of the four children's records evaluated, the following information was missing:  1. Three lacked information regarding special needs  2. One lacked the address for the emergency contact  3. One was behind with immunizations  4. One lacked a health care statement  5. Two lacked the name and phone number of the school they attend.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §747.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children: A list of children being transported is not in the vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - List of Children (26 TAC §747.5417(a)(1))
